title: Title: The Akedah II — The Binding of Isaac, Part 2
summary: Opening title slide of the second lesson on the Akedah (the binding of Isaac), shown over a video still of the presenter in front of a world map.

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter in a white T-shirt sitting on a brown couch in front of a large wall map of the world, with both arms raised and hands clasped over his head and face. The lesson title is overlaid in blue and white.
pictures.text_in_picture: The Akedah II · העקדה · The Briding of Isaac Part 2
